item.title: Version 3.4.6
item.description:
The app now starts on macOS 11 through 25, and automatic updates work for the first time.

  • The app did not start at all below macOS 26. Every release since launch carried a Python runtime compiled for macOS 26, so the system refused to load it before any application code ran. No icon, no window, no error. If you are reading this in the app, you were never affected, but many people were.
  • Automatic updates had never run. This updater has been built in since 3.4.0 and failed silently on every launch. That is fixed, which is why you are seeing this notice at all.

Both defects are now checked by the build itself, so neither can come back unnoticed.

Requires Apple Silicon. Intel is not supported.

item.title: Version 3.4.5
item.description:
Fixes driver installation failing on first launch, while the app reported success.

  • The driver folder is now created before the driver is copied into it. On Macs where no audio plug-in had ever been installed, /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/HAL/ did not exist, so the copy failed and routing never started.
  • A failed installation is no longer reported as success. The app now states that the installation failed, shows the exact commands to check and work around it, and points to the log file.

If you ever installed AudioRouterNow and it never routed any audio, this is very likely why. Update, then run the driver installation again.

No action required for anyone whose routing already works. Update normally.

item.title: Version 3.4.4
item.description:
Fixes audio routing to devices with non-ASCII characters in their internal ID.

  • Devices with special-character IDs now route correctly. A few audio interfaces report an internal identifier containing non-Latin characters (for example, certain Pebble V3 units). On those devices routing could silently fail to engage. This is now fixed.

No action required. Update normally.

item.title: Version 3.4.3
item.description:
Persistent menu for everyone — and the uninstaller no longer freezes.

  • Persistent menu for everyone. The menu that stays open while you work is now the default for all users, including those updating from an earlier version.
  • Uninstaller no longer freezes. The uninstall process now runs in the background — no more 30+ second spinning wheel.
  • Double-click protection on Uninstall. Prevents accidentally triggering the uninstaller twice since the menu stays open.

No action required. Update normally.

item.title: Version 3.4.2
item.description:
Audio reliability fixes plus a friendlier, more informative menu.

  • All your outputs are now audible after routing. Your current volume level is carried across to every device AudioRouterNow routes to.
  • No more brief drop-outs when adding a third output. Adding another output on multi-output setups no longer cuts out the others.
  • The menu stays open while you set things up.
  • The menu bar icon no longer cries wolf. It stays green when audio is still routing fine.
  • New: Help → Status Guide. A built-in colour legend for the menu bar icon states.

No action required. Update normally.
